description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint using Flask-Smorest. It includes the creation of a Blueprint and a class-based view to respond with a 'Healthy' message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView class that handles GET requests for the health check endpoint, returning a simple JSON message indicating the service is healthy.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check route, returning a JSON object with a 'Healthy' message.
